dedupe_keys.name: hydrological forecasts of water level and temperature for latvian stations lvgmc open data

description: The Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre publishes medium-range forecasts of two hydrological parameters, water temperature and water level, for points on Latvian water bodies where it runs hydrological observation stations, as an open dataset on the national data portal. The dataset holds the spread of daily mean values of an ensemble forecast for 14 days at a one-day step: water temperature in degrees Celsius and water level in metres above sea level in the Latvian normal height system (LAS-2000,5). The ensemble median and ensemble ranges (full, 25 to 75 per cent and 5 to 95 per cent) are computed, verified and published as the latest forecast, and a new forecast is passed from the centre's databases to the portal as soon as it is prepared. Station locations and height conversions are in a linked hydrometeorological observations dataset, joined by station code. The data is a CSV resource meant for machine reading, with filter examples for one station, under a CC0 licence; it is marked as a high-value dataset. Caveats: a station with technical problems can be dropped from the forecasts for an indefinite time, and the update frequency is given as irregular. Coverage is Latvia. It supports flood hazard exposure and emergency response for bridges, roads and riverside infrastructure; related records are the Icelandic hydrometric network and the Bulgarian flood hazard and risk maps.
